name: rtl-cursor
description: Smart RTL for VS Code Chat and Agents, Cursor and Antigravity (Chat, Agent, Plan, Canvas, and Markdown). Preserves native fonts and user font settings. RTL text is right-aligned; code and English stay left-to-right.

rtlCursor.loadBundledVazirmatn.description: Load bundled Vazirmatn Regular and Bold in the editor window and Canvas. Does not change any font setting. To use it, select Vazirmatn in the editor's font settings. Reload the window after changing this option.

rtlCursor.autoReapply.description: After an editor update, re-apply the RTL patch automatically if you had it enabled

rtlCursor.autoRelaunch.description: After Enable, Disable, or automatic repair after a completed update, gracefully quit and relaunch the editor. Works in Agent mode without opening the IDE; never force-closes the editor.

rtlCursor.showStatusBar.description: نمایش دکمه وضعیت RTL در نوار وضعیت ادیتور
